evidence.quote: The balance between the two case studies needs improving. There is more detail about the Bulgarian context and this weakens the comparison between Italy and Bulgaria and the conclusions drawn from this comparison. More information about the role played by self-help organizations in Italy would be very helpful since the person interviewed appears to have relied more on her personal transnational networks, especially her partner in Sweden with whom she shares a child.

Partnership brought far away emotional support, but concrete help came from the mentioned “sisterhood” in the local shelter. Unfortunately, we could not explore further the shelter and related refugees’ women dynamics for lack of time and resources.
